title: QVC INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: QVC, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, disclosing entry into a Restructuring Support Agreement with holders of approximately $6.55 billion in outstanding debt (QVC Notes, LINTA Notes, and Credit Facility) to implement a prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the Southern District of Texas. The restructuring contemplates approximately $1.3 billion in takeback debt and a $300 million debtor-in-possession letter of credit facility.
key_points: QVC Group entered Restructuring Support Agreement on April 16, 2026 with Consenting QVC Noteholders, Consenting LINTA Noteholders, and Consenting RCF Lenders
Approximately $2.15 billion of QVC Notes, $1.5 billion of LINTA Notes, and $2.9 billion under the Credit Facility are subject to restructuring (~$6.55 billion total)
Restructuring will be implemented through prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Southern District of Texas
Reorganized QVC will issue approximately $1.3 billion in aggregate original principal amount of takeback debt
A $300 million DIP LC Facility will be established with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as agent, cash collateralized by $315 million
Non-funded debt general unsecured claims (trade claims, contract and lease claims) will be unimpaired under the Plan
why_it_matters: This is a significant corporate credit event involving a large retail/media company with publicly traded notes (QVCD, QVCC on NYSE).
